SELECT 'CR_ALL' AS source_type, v.id, v.file_id, v.gene, v.chr, v.pos, v.transcript_id, v.exon, v.chgvs, v.phgvs, v.zygosity, v.exonic_func, v.c1000g2015aug_all, v.exac_eas, v.clinvar_id, v.sift_pred, v.polyphen2_hdiv_pred, v.mutation_taster_pred, v.depth, v.revel, v.gnomad_genome_all, v.interpro_domain, v.clnsig, v.omim_phenotypes, v.omim_id, v.hgmd_tag, v.hgmd_disease, v.hgmd_pmid, v.classification_lovd, v.clinical_significance_clinvar, v.source, v.clinical_significance_enigma, v.variant, v.ori_variant, v.parent_mutation_id, v.is_reported, v.filtered_rationale, v.reviewed_by, v.reviewed_at FROM file_CR_ALL v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id

UPDATE file_CR_ALL v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id SET v.is_reported = #{isReported}, v.filtered_rationale = #{filteredRationale}, v.reviewed_by = #{operatorId}, v.reviewed_at = NOW(), v.update_by = #{operatorId}, v.update_time = NOW() WHERE v.id = #{sourceId} AND f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.analysis_id AS analysisId, r.subbarcode AS subbarcode, r.product AS product, r.product_id AS productId, r.template AS template, r.template_id AS templateId, r.analysis_disease AS disease, r.cancer_type AS cancerType, r.status AS status, t.template_code AS templateCode, t.template_version AS templateVersion, t.module_code AS moduleCode FROM analysis_report r LEFT JOIN report_template t ON t.template_id = r.template_id AND t.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.del_flag = '0'

SELECT 'SNP_INDEL' AS sourceType, v.id AS sourceId, v.gene AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, v.exonic_func_known_gene AS mutationTypeRaw, v.mut_freq AS frequency, CONCAT(IFNULL(v.mut_depth, ''), '/', IFNULL(v.total_depth, '')) AS depth, f.file_type AS fileType, v.mut_freq AS freqRaw, v.cosmic91 AS cosmic, v.parent_mutation_id AS parentMutationId, NULL AS fusionQuality FROM file_Somatic_SNV_Indel v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id WHERE f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.is_reported = 1 AND v.del_flag = '0' AND f.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 'CNV' AS sourceType, v.id AS sourceId, v.gene AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, 'CNV' AS mutationTypeRaw, v.copy_num AS frequency, NULL AS depth, f.file_type AS fileType, v.copy_num AS freqRaw, NULL AS cosmic, v.parent_mutation_id AS parentMutationId, NULL AS fusionQuality FROM file_CNV v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id WHERE f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.is_reported = 1 AND v.del_flag = '0' AND f.del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 'FUSION' AS sourceType, v.id AS sourceId, IFNULL(CONCAT(v.gene1, '-', v.gene2), v.gene) AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, 'FUSION' AS mutationTypeRaw, v.freq AS frequency, v.depth AS depth, f.file_type AS fileType, v.freq AS freqRaw, v.cosmic_info AS cosmic, v.parent_mutation_id AS parentMutationId, v.tag AS fusionQuality FROM file_Fusion v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id WHERE f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.is_reported = 1 AND v.del_flag = '0' AND f.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sourceId

SELECT 'CR_ALL' AS sourceType, v.id AS sourceId, v.gene AS gene, v.variant AS variant, v.ori_variant AS oriVariant, v.exonic_func AS mutationTypeRaw, v.zygosity AS zygosity, v.depth AS depth, v.clnsig AS clnsig, v.parent_mutation_id AS parentMutationId, f.file_type AS fileType, NULL AS freqRaw, NULL AS cosmic, NULL AS fusionQuality FROM file_CR_ALL v JOIN data_file_status f ON f.file_id = v.file_id WHERE f.analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND v.is_reported = 1 AND v.del_flag = '0' AND f.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sourceId
